questions.question: The source retains the general statements about the Candidate degree and almost forty years of teaching; verify the defence and appointment dates if they are to be added. Confirm the descriptive English game names, including Mathematical Rally for the event with a warm-up, three stages and a finish.

localizations.source: The source retains the general statements about the Candidate degree and almost forty years of teaching; verify the defence and appointment dates if they are to be added. Confirm the descriptive English game names, including Mathematical Rally for the event with a warm-up, three stages and a finish.
localizations.ru: В исходнике сохранены родовые сведения о кандидатской степени и работе почти 40 лет; при финальной вычитке уточнить даты защиты и начала работы, если редактор хочет их добавить. Названия игровых форм в EN переданы описательно; подтвердить Mathematical Rally для «математического кросса» по разделу книги с разминкой, тремя этапами и финишем.

questions.resolution: The article can stand with the dates it gives. Mathematical Rally is clear in the context of a multi-stage activity.

questions.question: Verify the dates of Dyshinsky’s deanship: the article gave 1976–1986, while Perm State Humanitarian Pedagogical University’s faculty history gives 1975–1985.

localizations.source: Verify the dates of Dyshinsky’s deanship: the article gave 1976–1986, while Perm State Humanitarian Pedagogical University’s faculty history gives 1975–1985.
localizations.ru: Сверить годы деканства Е. А. Дышинского: в статье были указаны 1976–1986 годы, а в историческом материале математического факультета ПГГПУ — 1975–1985 годы.

questions.resolution: Both editions now use 1975–1985, as stated in the official faculty history: https://open.pspu.ru/matdo/Подробнее.pdf
